acceptanceCriteria: `go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/service/` passes on darwin with TMPDIR under a symlinked ancestor (for example /tmp/... or the default /var/folders/...) and with a resolved TMPDIR.
A failed log-sink open fails TestSERVICE500_LogSinkIOErrorIsReportedNotBlocking within seconds rather than hanging to the package timeout.
The darwin full gate (local and hosted macos-15) passes internal/tasks/service.
body: Found by the 1.0.0-rc.2 release gate on candidate 0ae3f88d: local darwin/arm64 `make gate` and hosted macos-15 full-gate both FAIL in internal/tasks/service. TestSERVICE500_HelperRecordIsBounded (`openat var: not a directory`), TestSERVICE500_LogSinkRotatesWithinTwoFiles (all bytes dropped, LOG_IO_ERROR openat var), TestSERVICE500_LogSinkDropsBeyondBufferWithoutBlocking (dropped 101, want 100), and TestSERVICE500_LogSinkIOErrorIsReportedNotBlocking blocks on an unread gate send until `panic: test timed out after 30m0s`. Cause: the tests pass raw t.TempDir() (/var/folders/... on macOS, /var -> /private/var) to safeopen.Root, which by contract refuses a symlink anywhere in the path; lifecycle_test.go already resolves with filepath.EvalSymlinks. Reproduce: TMPDIR=/tmp/x go test ./internal/tasks/service/ on macOS. Product behavior is unchanged (production roots are resolved). Same class as V1-0753 (internal/tasks/store). Fix on branch claude/rc2-gate-fixes: resolvedTempDir test helper, and the wedged-writer send is bounded so a failed open fails fast instead of hanging.

completion.reason: internal/tasks/service symlinked-TMPDIR and hanging log-sink test fixed in the rc.2 full-gate test-defect batch; internal/tasks/service passes on hosted macos-15 (8.3s) and locally. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: tests: internal/tasks/service log-sink and helper-record tests fail, and one hangs 30m, when TMPDIR has a symlinked ancestor (macOS /var)
